Mesh laundry bags work by providing a protective layer between the items contained within it and other items in the washer. The Wash Bag gives you a safe way to launder lingerie and other delicate items of clothing.

The mesh laundry bags are made from breathable polyester fiber that protects the garments during the laundry process. It also features a protected zipper to prevent the clothes from falling out. The primary use for mesh laundry bags is to protect delicate fabrics in the wash. Placing items inside a mesh bag prevents them from getting damaged, especially if you have a mixed laundry load.

Another way to use them is to separate certain articles of clothing from the rest of the laundry.

You can also use laundry bags to prevent items from getting misplaced in the washer. For example, keeping socks together or to prevent mixing articles with another person’s clothing.

Be sure to not overfill your bag. Garments need to be able to move around to get clean.

description:
Contains 3 large (28"x20"), 6 medium (24"x16"), and 6 small (22"x14") space saver bags for travel.

 

FAQ:

How much can you pack inside each bag?

The largest size can fit four sweaters/four pairs of jeans/two jackets/eight tshirts, or even a blanket. The medium size fits 30% less, and the smallest size fits 50% less. The smallest size is especially useful for storing socks/underwear.

 

How does the bag stay compressed?

StoragePro uses a patented design that efficiently expels air while preventing reverse airflow. When squeezed, air inside the bag gets pushed through little side passageways which channel into two exit valves. The valves are covered by two layers of thin film that only open with sufficient force applied, making them one-way only. As outside air pressure overcomes the pressure inside, the bag remains compressed until the seal is opened.

 

One of the bags keeps re-inflating with air after a while. What am I doing wrong?

Don't worry; this is common for new users of space saver bags. The trick is to pack just the right amount and not overpack with clothes, which may slowly break open the seal over time. Pack just below the "fill line" marked on the bag, so that you can build a safety gap of compressed air between your clothing and the ziploc seal. This also allows you to roll easier when squeezing out the air.

 

Do clothes come out wrinkled after packing and rolling?

Surprisingly, not much! As long as you folded your clothes before packing, you'll be glad to notice that they come out no more wrinkled than from the folding itself.

 

Do bags reduce weight as well as volume?

No. If they did, we'd win the Nobel Prize in Physics.

description:
Contains 3 large (28"x20"), 6 medium (24"x16"), and 6 small (22"x14") space saver bags for travel.

 

FAQ:

How much can you pack inside each bag?

The largest size can fit four sweaters/four pairs of jeans/two jackets/eight tshirts, or even a blanket. The medium size fits 30% less, and the smallest size fits 50% less. The smallest size is especially useful for storing socks/underwear.

 

How does the bag stay compressed?

StoragePro uses a patented design that efficiently expels air while preventing reverse airflow. When squeezed, air inside the bag gets pushed through little side passageways which channel into two exit valves. The valves are covered by two layers of thin film that only open with sufficient force applied, making them one-way only. As outside air pressure overcomes the pressure inside, the bag remains compressed until the seal is opened.

 

One of the bags keeps re-inflating with air after a while. What am I doing wrong?

Don't worry; this is common for new users of space saver bags. The trick is to pack just the right amount and not overpack with clothes, which may slowly break open the seal over time. Pack just below the "fill line" marked on the bag, so that you can build a safety gap of compressed air between your clothing and the ziploc seal. This also allows you to roll easier when squeezing out the air.

 

Do clothes come out wrinkled after packing and rolling?

Surprisingly, not much! As long as you folded your clothes before packing, you'll be glad to notice that they come out no more wrinkled than from the folding itself.

 

Do bags reduce weight as well as volume?

No. If they did, we'd win the Nobel Prize in Physics.

7. After pumping the gas, tighten the pumping door and cover the dust cover to complete the process.

Easy to Use: 4 Simple Steps to Save Space and Keep Your Closet Organized!

1. Pack
Ensure that everything you want to store is clean and completely dry. Open up the bag on a flat surface and undo the zip. Fold the materials and put them inside the bag carefully. Stack items on top of each other, but do not overfill. Make sure that there are a couple of centimeters spare from the edges of the clothes etc and the zip closure.

2. Zip
With the items in place, use the plastic clip to zip along sealing the two plastic zips. Go back over the zips to ensure it is fully sealed. The surest way is to run the clip fully from end to end in both directions, and then to run your hand along the whole length of the zip between finger and thumb to ensure that there’s no tiny section missed. Please be noted that the clip is not fixed by design, so don’t panic when it falls off.

3. Vac
When ready, undo the valve lid by unscrewing it, and then place the vacuum cleaner nozzle with no attachments on it over the valve. You simply need to press it against the valve, and then turn the vacuum on. It will then start to remove the air. You don’t need a perfect seal against the valve, but keep pressing it on firmly and the air will be extracted. Please be noted that

4. Store
After vacuuming all the air out of the bag, stop and close the cap quickly to secure an air-tight seal. Listen carefully for any signs of air leaking out of the cap or other zipped parts of the bag. Repeat step 2 if necessary. If the bags are tightly sealed, congratulations, you can put them under your bed or wherever you think is suitable.

Tips For Packing

description:
Mesh laundry bags work by providing a protective layer between the items contained within it and other items in the washer. The Wash Bag gives you a safe way to launder lingerie and other delicate items of clothing.

The mesh laundry bags are made from breathable polyester fiber that protects the garments during the laundry process. It also features a protected zipper to prevent the clothes from falling out. The primary use for mesh laundry bags is to protect delicate fabrics in the wash. Placing items inside a mesh bag prevents them from getting damaged, especially if you have a mixed laundry load.

Another way to use them is to separate certain articles of clothing from the rest of the laundry.

You can also use laundry bags to prevent items from getting misplaced in the washer. For example, keeping socks together or to prevent mixing articles with another person’s clothing.

Be sure to not overfill your bag. Garments need to be able to move around to get clean.

description:
Easy to Use: 4 Simple Steps to Save Space and Keep Your Closet Organized!

1. Pack
Ensure that everything you want to store is clean and completely dry. Open up the bag on a flat surface and undo the zip. Fold the materials and put them inside the bag carefully. Stack items on top of each other, but do not overfill. Make sure that there are a couple of centimeters spare from the edges of the clothes etc and the zip closure.

2. Zip
With the items in place, use the plastic clip to zip along sealing the two plastic zips. Go back over the zips to ensure it is fully sealed. The surest way is to run the clip fully from end to end in both directions, and then to run your hand along the whole length of the zip between finger and thumb to ensure that there’s no tiny section missed. Please be noted that the clip is not fixed by design, so don’t panic when it falls off.

3. Vac
When ready, undo the valve lid by unscrewing it, and then place the vacuum cleaner nozzle with no attachments on it over the valve. You simply need to press it against the valve, and then turn the vacuum on. It will then start to remove the air. You don’t need a perfect seal against the valve, but keep pressing it on firmly and the air will be extracted. Please be noted that

4. Store
After vacuuming all the air out of the bag, stop and close the cap quickly to secure an air-tight seal. Listen carefully for any signs of air leaking out of the cap or other zipped parts of the bag. Repeat step 2 if necessary. If the bags are tightly sealed, congratulations, you can put them under your bed or wherever you think is suitable.

The zipper is water-resistant, but in the case that any of your liquids do leak while you’re traveling, the pouch is simple to clean.
